note.question: How can a global procurement coalition set country prices and manufacturer subsidies so scarce vaccines are allocated fairly and efficiently while countries and manufacturers still accept bilateral deals?
note.overview: The proposed procurement mechanism combines bilateral Nash bargaining with a Fisher-market allocation/clearing equilibrium and an outer coalition design problem.
